name: vivid-firestore-rules-tests
description: Tests de firestore.rules contra el emulador de Firestore (CI)
test: node --test rules.test.js > "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/vivid_rules.log" 2>&1; VIVID_CODE=$?; cat "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/vivid_rules.log"; if [ "$VIVID_CODE" -ne 0 ]; then VIVID_N=0; grep -E '✖|✕|not ok|# fail|AssertionError|assertion|Error:|PERMISSION|permission' "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/vivid_rules.log" | while IFS= read -r VIVID_LINE && [ "$VIVID_N" -lt 10 ]; do printf '::error title=rules::%s\n' "$(printf '%s' "$VIVID_LINE" | sed 's/%/%25/g' | cut -c1-230)"; VIVID_N=$((VIVID_N + 1)); done; fi; exit "$VIVID_CODE"
